name: smwmusic-sacred-harp-murillo-s-music-box
title: Sacred Harp - Murillo's Music Box
description:
I started this one as another Sacred Harp Port, song no. 358, Murillo's lesson; Then saw some potential for tweaking.
So I gave it a musicbox-like instrumentation and a Lydian Dominant mode instead of the original Major Scale.

In fact, I find it quite funny to use for P-Switch. But as the timing of P-Switch is shorter, feel free to use it in your Overworlds or Switch Palaces.

Edit of Jan. 22: This was done for my QLDC entry last year. Some instrumentations and volumes are re-worked because it was too low in-game.
